simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to טֹרַח (H2960) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.

simple.summary: טֹרַח (ṭôrach) means a burden First listed occurrence: Deut 1 12.

definitions.full: H2960. torach טֹ֫רַח noun masculine budren , figurative נְשׂא׃ נִלְאֵיתִי לָטֹ֑רַח עָלַי הָיוּ Isa 1:14 they are become a burden on me, I am weary of bearing ; טָרְחֲכֶם אֶשָּׂא אֵיכָה Deut 1:12 (+ וְרֵיבְכֶם מַשַּׂאֲכֶם ) how can I bear the burden of you ?
